claim_ceiling: Authored candidate specification row only; no observed result, active policy, released case or employment effect.

fields.calculation: A rule-bound suggestion linked to a low or incomplete *observable response behavior*, a citation, and a small practice action. After numeric review, prioritize one rated dimension at `≤2` with a specific missed opportunity; if all rated dimensions are `3–4`, offer a refinement exercise.
fields.display_gate: Human-reviewed evidence and no unresolved transcript/case issue for that dimension.
fields.interpretation: Actionable practice, never a deficit diagnosis. The participant can inspect why it was suggested.
fields.label: Next exercise
